## Summary
Roshan Damor is a Software Engineer specializing in scalable backend architecture, full-stack systems, distributed cloud services, and production AI/LLM applications. He is the creator and architect of CardFlow SaaS (1,000+ users, 136,000+ ID cards processed) and VidyaMaxx (AI-first unified school management platform).

## Primary Production Projects
- [CardFlow](https://logicbyroshan.in/projects/cardflow): Production SaaS ID card management and generation system with automated queue processing, serving 1,000+ active enterprise/school users and 136,000+ processed cards. Stack: Python, Django, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Docker.
- [VidyaMaxx](https://logicbyroshan.in/projects/vidyamaxx): Comprehensive AI-driven school management ERP unifying academic reporting, administrative operations, fee management, and parent communication. Stack: Python, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Redis.
- [PrintNexx](https://logicbyroshan.in/projects/printnexx): High-throughput automated image processing and card finishing pipeline utilizing OpenCV and Python for print production.
- [EazeTrip](https://logicbyroshan.in/projects/eazetrip): B2B travel operations management platform for bookings, client workflows, and inventory tracking.
- [TaskFlixx](https://logicbyroshan.in/projects/taskflixx): AI-powered contextual task management and developer workflow automation application.
- [PrepSarthi](https://logicbyroshan.in/projects/prepsarthi): Adaptive learning platform featuring automated question generation and exam readiness evaluation.

- **Computer Science Fundamentals**: Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Design, System Design, Distributed Systems, Database Optimization
